name: How should I prepare my home before a drywall texturing appointment?
description: Clear the work area, protect valuables, and locate your existing paint codes or leftover paint cans for the final touch-up.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a drywall texturing appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a drywall contractor arrives, clear furniture and wall decor at least four to five feet away from the work zone. Take clear photos of the damage alongside a coin or tape measure if requesting an estimate remotely. Because spray texturing generates airborne mist and fine sanding dust, professional crews mask floors and plastic-wrap nearby items. Knowing the original paint sheen and keeping leftover paint codes on hand also helps ensure seamless final blending.
